note.zh-TW: 年報用最近五年合計；模板只算單期。教材口徑標「單期近似」，有多期資料時改用五年合計；分母為 0 一律 N/A。
note.en: Annual reports use the latest five years in total; the template uses one period. The course version is marked as a single-period approximation and switches to the five-year total when the data exist; a zero denominator always gives N/A.

definition.zh-TW: 營業活動產生的現金，能不能支應資本支出、存貨增加與現金股利這三項需要。數值越高表示本業的現金越夠用。
definition.en: Whether cash from operating activities covers capital expenditure, inventory growth and cash dividends. Higher means operating cash is more sufficient.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
